note: Architecture only. Hazards use environmental conditions and authentic safety procedures, not arcade damage. None are implemented in Phase 4.

hazards.name: Flash flood
hazards.authenticResponse: Move to higher ground. Do not enter flowing water.

hazards.name: Thunderstorm
hazards.authenticResponse: Seek sturdy shelter. Avoid ridgelines and open water.

hazards.name: Hurricane
hazards.authenticResponse: Evacuate or shelter according to the forecast and local guidance.

hazards.name: Tornado
hazards.authenticResponse: Move to an interior, lowest-level shelter. Stay away from windows.

hazards.name: Landslide
hazards.authenticResponse: Leave the slide path. Do not return for belongings.

hazards.name: Earthquake
hazards.authenticResponse: Drop, cover, and hold on. After shaking, watch for aftershocks and damaged ground.

hazards.name: Volcanic hazard
hazards.authenticResponse: Follow exclusion zones. Avoid valleys that can carry lahars.

hazards.name: Tsunami
hazards.authenticResponse: Move inland and uphill immediately. Do not wait for an official wave.

hazards.name: Wildfire
hazards.authenticResponse: Leave early on a known route. Do not shelter in dense smoke.

hazards.name: Winter storm
hazards.authenticResponse: Stay sheltered. Avoid travel on untreated roads and exposed ridges.
